title: Billing
description: Subscription and invoice health for the platform's SaaS billing layer.

panels.title: Subscriptions by status
panels.query: sacco_subscriptions_total{status=*} — latest value per status label (active/trialing/past_due/suspended/cancelled).

panels.title: Subscriptions by status (trend)
panels.query: sacco_subscriptions_total{status=*} plotted over time, one series per status label, to show migration between states (e.g. active -> past_due).

panels.title: MRR by currency
panels.query: sacco_subscriptions_mrr{currency=*} — latest value per currency label. Sum of active/trialing subscriptions' plan base_price.

panels.title: MRR trend
panels.query: sacco_subscriptions_mrr{currency=*} plotted over time, one series per currency label.

panels.title: Outstanding invoices by status
panels.query: sacco_invoices_outstanding{status=*} — latest value per status label (issued/partial/overdue).
